title: Haye amma
body:
haye amma meri amma
amma na hamein chod ke jao
naraaz ho kyun kuch to batao
<<DIVIDER>>
bin aap ke ek pal na sukoon paunga amma
jab tak na bulaogi na paas aunga amma
ab uth ke kaleje se lagao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa maine suna aap ka pehlu hai shikasta
ruksaar pe kis shakhs ne maara hai tamacha
shabbir ko bas itna batao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aap ka beta bada maghmoom hai amma
zakhmi hai badan aap ka maloom hai amma
baba ko utho zakhm dikhao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein bhi aap ko zaalim ne sataya
aur pehlu pe jalta hua darwaza giraya
marham utho zakhmon pe lagao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
markaz pe khada ashk bahaega ye mazloom
amma utho roti hai bahot zainab o kulsoom
behno ki mere aas bandhao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hum ko sula kar hi sada soti thi amma
hum se kabhi naraaz nahi hoti thi amma
pyasa hoo bahot pani pilao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
phat'ta hai jigar dekha nahi jaata hai manzar
ghurbat mere baba ki zara dekho to uthkar
chehre se kafan apne hatao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chaunk ke uth jaata tha mai raaton ko aksar
tab lori sunaati thi mujhe godh mein lekar
phir mujhko wohi lori sunao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o aalam hai yehi dil mein tamanna
ay kaash sada aaye yehi sayyade waala
bachpan ka mera nauha sunao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
author: Alam Sultanpuri
